Start: Dualcaster Mage (hand); Saw in Half (hand)
Prerequisites: You control at least one creature.
  You have enough mana to cast Saw in Half
Steps: Cast Saw in Half by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
  Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.

  Repeat from step 3.
